newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Australian invests A$1.25 mln in Kiwi Gold.
newsitem.headline: Australian invests A$1.25 mln in Kiwi Gold.

text.p: Kiwi Gold on Monday said Texwood Pty, a company controlled by Ian Trahar, had agreed to make an investment in the company of A$1.255 million.

"Mr Trahar is an Australian resident with extensive experience in the resource and finance industries. It is intended that Mr Trahar will become the Chairman of the company," Kiwi said in a statement.

Kiwi said it anticipated that the injection of capital and the introduction of a shareholder with access to significant expertise would assist the company to achieve its objective of identifying new ventures as well as increase the company's capacity to make acquisitions.
"The company has entered into an agreement to allot and issue 25.1 million ordinary shares and 25.1 million options in the company to Texwood.
"The ordinary shares will have an issue price of A$0.05 (to be converted into NZ dollars on the date of issue) resulting in an initial cash injection into the company of A$1.255 million," Kiwi said.
The issue would give Texwood 24.44 percent of the issued capital of the company (before the exercise of options).
